summary: StudentEOrientation is a user control that manages student access to e-orientation courses, tracks completion status, enables certificate printing, and allows course retake under specific conditions. It handles system interactions, displays information depending on session state, and communicates with a reporting framework to generate certificates.
purpose: To provide students with access to e-orientation courses, track their progress and completion, facilitate printing certificates of completion, and enable course retake functionality based on predefined rules.

workflows.name: Retake E-Orientation Course
steps: Student sees retake button if course completed and PRDEndDate is valid.
On retake button click, confirmation dialog is shown.
If confirmed, client script triggers form submission.
Student retake method called with session, course ID, and student ID.
Course data is rebound to reflect changes.

workflows.name: Print Certificate of Completion
steps: Reporting framework generates certificate report HTML.
If report HTML is available, label is updated and panel is made visible.

workflows.name: Course Data Binding
steps: Page binds data using student session and ID.
Data source parameters are set as UserSession and StudentID.
Session checked for authenticity before proceeding.

workflows.name: Open Moodle E-Orientation Site
steps: URL generated depending on session and system flag (USE_YARP).
Client-side script opens e-orientation as new window.

business_rules: Retake button visible only if course completed and CanRetakeCourse returns true, and PRDEndDate is not default value.
CanRetakeCourse returns true only for SystemAdministrator or StudentUser matching StudentID and not in SwitchUserViewOnly mode.
Print certificate functionality available only when course is completed.
validations: Session must be valid for data binding and workflow execution.
PRDEndDate must not be default ticks value (599266080000000000) for retake eligibility.
UserSession.StudentID must match StudentID for student actions.
calculations: PRDEndDate comparison uses .Ticks to distinguish valid dates from system defaults.
DueDate compared to today's date plus warning threshold to flag urgency.
conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel data source operation.
If Student completes course, Print Certificate panel becomes visible.
Retake button only shows if status is Completed and PRDEndDate is valid.
system_behavior: Panels and controls display based on session state and completion.
Certificate generation uses reporting framework with session and student ID.
OpenMoodleSite launches orientation URL in new browser window.
dependencies: HSPnetSession object for authentication and authorization.
Resources for label and dialog text.
ETopicCourse data for course workflow logic.
exceptions: If session is invalid, course data binding is cancelled.
If PRDEndDate is default (SQL null or min), retake button is hidden.
content_gaps: Some referenced resources and reporting methods are external and not fully defined in the available content.
The underlying ETopicCourse data model and its specific fields are not fully detailed.
UI/UX details and actual course content are not included.
